site_name: Bus Shelter And Advertising Right Outside 9
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the reports, specifications and drawings detailed Site Plan & Images (ref: 0132/0040); Technical Specification Document.  
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme. 
Condition : 2 - The advertisement hereby approved shall not display any animated or video content unless it is below the VAMM maximum threshold. 
Reason:In the interest of highway safety and of the visual amenities of the locality in accordance with Council policy LP9 of the Local Plan and to comply with the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 3 - No music, smoke or sound shall be emitted from the advertisements. 
Reason: In the interest of the aural amenities of the locality in accordance with Council Policy LP2 and LP9 of the Local Plan.
Condition : 4 - INFORMATIVE: The footway and carriageway of the A219/Putney Hill should not be blocked during the relocation and installation works. Temporary obstructions during the development works should be kept to a minimum and should not encroach on the clear space needed to provide safe passage for pedestrians or obstruct the flow of traffic on the  A219/Putney Hill. All vehicles should only park/stop at permitted locations and within the time periods permitted by existing on-street restrictions. 

INFORMATIVE: No skips or construction materials shall be kept on the footway or carriageway on the TLRN at any time.

INFORMATIVE: Bus services and passengers waiting on the pavement should not be impacted during the replacement of the advertisement panel.

INFORMATIVE: All vehicles associated with the installation and maintenance of adverts must only park/ stop at permitted locations and within the time periods permitted by existing on-street restrictions.
description: Display of 2 x Internally Illuminated sequential advertisement screens, with static and dynamic content display capability and automatic rotation of images.
